declared_claims.text: The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.
A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.
A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.
Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.
Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.
Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.
A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.
One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.

parsed_response.narration: Rain spatters soot-dark stone as frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach, pressing against the guards holding the choke point tight. Nearby, a gate serjeant keeps a sharp eye on the roster board while managing the anxious crowd. A notice board lists new taxes, imposed curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol, drawing furtive glances from passersby. Threadbare watchers and ragged strangers cluster along the muddy gate line, their eyes shifting uneasily. A tavern runner loudly trades hot stew and whispered rumors near a rain barrel, cutting through the damp air. Overlooking the square, a well-appointed townhouse flies noble colors, standing in quiet contrast to the clamorous, muddy scene below. Just beyond, Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point, worsening the crowd's congestion. One figure in threadbare clothes stands unnervingly still, watching faces and pack animals more than the gate line itself.
